title: Inject the remaining cross-repo boundary reads

epic.name: Async test suite through dependency injection

story.i_want_to: the inner logic to receive the row a boundary read
story.so_that: the test passes its own row instead of committing one

rationale: The rest of the cross-repo group reads on AdminRepo (claim, precondition, candidates, custody halt) what the test wrote on Repo.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every converted module is `async: true`; the commit gate passes; production behaviour is unchanged (the injected input defaults to the value the code read before).
Each boundary keeps one test of the real read; the inner logic takes the row as a value.
Tests that rely on two transactions being independent (needs_commit_independence) stay in a sync module scoped to that test, with the reason stated.

technical_notes: Files (boundary noted): test/loopctl/delivery/completion_test.exs — Loopctl.Delivery.Completion.candidates (fleet-wide AdminRepo read) vs Stages on Repo; test/loopctl/delivery/dispatch_driver_test.exs — Loopctl.Progress.claim_story (AdminRepo) + Stages transition (Repo); DispatchDriver.candidates fleet-wide; test/loopctl/delivery/escalations_resolve_test.exs — Loopctl.Progress.force_unclaim_story/contract_story (AdminRepo) vs Stages (Repo); test/loopctl/delivery/merge_precondition_integration_test.exs — Loopctl.Delivery.MergePrecondition.evaluate (story/intake/dispatch reads on AdminRepo); test/loopctl/delivery/placement_test.exs — Loopctl.Progress.claim_story (AdminRepo) + Stages transition (Repo); test/loopctl/delivery/post_deploy_verification_test.exs — PostDeployVerificationWorker candidate read + verification reads on AdminRepo; test/loopctl/delivery/session_end_release_test.exs — Loopctl.Delivery.RunnerStages.end_session release (AdminRepo) vs ledger (Repo); test/loopctl/delivery/triage_trigger_test.exs — Loopctl.WorkBreakdown.Stories.create_story (AdminRepo) then Stages.open (Repo); test/loopctl/runners/dispatch_ledger_test.exs — Fixtures commit tenant/runner via AdminRepo; DispatchLedger FKs on Repo; test/loopctl_web/controllers/story_stage_report_controller_test.exs — Loopctl.Progress.claim_story (AdminRepo) + Stages transition (Repo); test/loopctl_web/live/thread_live_halt_test.exs — Loopctl.Runners.custody_halted?
